name: Quilt
author: Ugurcan Bulut
description: Tile layout presets on a 10- or 12-column grid, with drop areas for empty tiles

barWidget.description: Tile layout presets on a 10- or 12-column grid, with drop areas for empty tiles

schema.label: Show built-in layouts
schema.description: Turn off to keep only the adaptive layouts (Smart, Dwindle, Scrolling, Monocle) on the Built-in tab.

schema.label: Drop areas on empty tiles
schema.description: Outline empty tiles with a + you can click to open an app there.

schema.label: Arrow keys reach empty tiles
schema.description: On a grid layout, Super+arrows stop on empty tiles too, and Super+Shift+arrows move a window into them. Only while those keys are Omarchy's own.

schema.label: Scroll on the bar icon to resize
schema.description: Scrolling on the bar icon widens or narrows the focused window's column.

schema.label: Extra windows
schema.description: With more windows than tiles: tabs puts the extras in the last tile as tabs, stack squeezes them in beside its window.
